dict.string: Ayahsab ul Insan u An Yatruka Suda
Lā ḥawla wa-lā quwwata ʾillā bi-llāhi l-ʿalīyi l-aẓīm
Subhan Allah Wabihamdih Subhan Allah Al Azeem
Allah Noor us Samawat Wal Ardh
Hoa Allah Allazi Lā ʾilāha ʾillā Hoo Alimul Ghaib Washahada Hoa Ar Rahman Ar Raheem
Ala Bi Zikri Allah Tatmainnul Quloob
Wa Jaa Rabbuk Wal Malaku Saffan Saffa
Kullu Aamin Wa Antum b Khair
Iqra bismi Rabbi kal lazee khalaq
Lā ḥawla wa-lā quwwata ʾillā bi-llāh
Ala Bi Zikri Allah Tatmainnul Quloob
Yoma La Yanfau Malun Wala Banoon, Illa Man Ata Allah Bi Qalbin Saleem
The foundation of wisdom is the fear of Allah Almighty.
Innama Yakhsh Allah Min Ebadih Al Ulama
